reviewer: self-review by the author's session against skills/critic/SKILL.md (no separate critic agent was run)
summary: 21 repeatable routine cards, three for each first-year course spell and Ward, each with a spell option (up[spell]) and two options that resolve without it. Retrieval found one duplicate premise (reading tomorrow's Ledger page early: ledger_office_drying_line), which was replaced; lines echoing existing cards were reworded (see the notes). Two cards sat at places simulated players almost never reach (the Gargoyle Passage, the Headmistress's Tower) and were replaced by cards at the library and the courtyard. The review pass also fixed sequence lines that assumed an earlier choice of the same option, two continuity slips, a lake hint that brushed the main mystery (now a pike), and summer showings of two frost scenes.
